# Windows 98 Calculator, Scientific view: the display after every key, read off the Reference PC
# (Bevel95's own measurement, 2026-11-12; the sequences of sci-sequences.txt). A sequence's name, then
# one key and the display text per line, then the marks that showed after the key: "[M]" the memory
# box shows M, "[(=n]" the parentheses box's text, "[Inv]" / "[Hyp]" the check box is ticked.
# Every sequence started in the Scientific view, Dec, Degrees, Inv/Hyp off, memory empty, no
# parenthesis open. Each row was taken once the screen had settled (two captures 300 ms apart agreed).
# s02: the Statistics Box was already open (moved off the indicators), so Sta only gave it the focus.
# s03: Sta reopened the box at its own place over the indicators; its row's marks are read as none
# (memory empty, no parenthesis).
